dict.string: AccessAble uses the camera to detect obstacles, read signs, and describe your surroundings. Images stay on your device unless you choose to ask AI.
AccessAble uses your location to give walking directions and announce nearby crossings and landmarks.
Allow location access at all times so a planned trip keeps announcing turns while your phone is in your pocket or locked.
Precise location is needed to announce turns at the right moment during your trip.
AccessAble listens when you hold the talk button so you can give voice commands and ask questions.
AccessAble turns your voice commands into actions like "start trip" or "describe my surroundings".
AccessAble uses motion data to track your steps between GPS updates for more accurate directions.
